title: Sigil and Hollow
author: Isandro Hartwell
blurb: Gideon Blackwood, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
